gloss: be done (passive); honorific; spontaneous (after godan verbs)

definitions.explanation: Attached to the a-row stem of a godan verb, it makes the passive: {書|か}く → {書|か}かれる (be written), {言|い}う → {言|い}われる (be told). する becomes される. The doer is marked with に, and the passive often shows that something happened to one against one's wishes.
The same form shows respect for the person doing the action: {先生|せんせい}が{話|はな}される (the teacher speaks). It is lighter than special honorific verbs and common in business and news.

definitions.gloss: spontaneous: something comes to mind or is felt
definitions.explanation: With verbs of thinking and feeling, it says that a thought or feeling arises by itself: {思|おも}われる (it seems), {偲|しの}ばれる (one is reminded of). Common in formal writing to soften a statement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: I was scolded by my mother.
I got bitten on the leg by a mosquito.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}われている→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: This song is still sung all over the world.
What time will you be going?

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{帰|かえ}られました→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The department head has already gone home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧されるそうです。
examples.english: I hear the teacher takes an hour's walk every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{偲|しの}ば→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧れる。
examples.english: It brings back the old days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{待|ま}た→待つ：00469_matsu⟧れる。
examples.english: The exam results are eagerly awaited.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧れる。
examples.english: It seems that this plan still has many problems.

notes:
FORMS:
The a-row stem of a godan verb + れる: ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ → ⟦{書|か}か→書く：00477_kaku⟧れる, ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → ⟦{読|よ}ま→読む：00426_yomu⟧れる, ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ → ⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧れる (う becomes わ). ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ → される. The result conjugates as an ichidan verb: ⟦{言|い}われない→言う：00515_iu⟧, ⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧, ⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧.

WATCH OUT:
- The potential of a godan verb is not 〜れる but the e-row form: ⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (can write), not ⟦{書|か}か→書く：00477_kaku⟧れる in modern speech.
- After ichidan verbs the standard ending is られる; {見|み}れる and {食|た}べれる are ら{抜|ぬ}き⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧, casual and nonstandard in writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- られる: the same auxiliary after ichidan verbs and ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧
- せる: the causative after godan verbs
